```{r}
dq_audit <- tibble(
  Check = c(
    "Total rows",
    "Missing values (any column)",
    "Negative margin (selling below cost)",
    "Stock-out + units sold > 0 (impossible)",
    "Zero units sold",
    "Discount > 0 but promo_flag = 0",
    "gross_sales ≠ units × list_price (rounding issues)"
  ),
  Count = c(
    nrow(df),
    sum(!complete.cases(df)),
    sum(df$margin_pct < 0),
    sum(df$stock_out_flag == 1 & df$units_sold > 0),
    sum(df$units_sold == 0),
    sum(df$discount_pct > 0 & df$promo_flag == 0),
    sum(abs(df$gross_sales -
              df$units_sold * df$list_price) > 0.02)
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    Pct    = paste0(round(Count / nrow(df) * 100, 3), "%"),
    Status = case_when(
      Check == "Total rows"   ~ "ℹ Info",
      Count == 0              ~ "✓ Pass",
      TRUE                    ~ "✗ Review"
    )
  )
print(dq_audit)
```

```{r}
n_raw <- nrow(df)
df_clean <- df %>%
  # Parse date properly
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  # Flag (don't remove) rows with negative margin
  # — keep them for investigation
  mutate(
    margin_flag = margin_pct < 0,
    stockout_contradiction = stock_out_flag == 1 & units_sold > 0
  ) %>%
  # Calculate actual discount amount
  mutate(
    discount_amt  = gross_sales - net_sales,
    effective_price = net_sales / units_sold,
    # Revenue metrics
    gross_margin_eur = net_sales - (units_sold * purchase_cost),
    gross_margin_pct = round(gross_margin_eur / net_sales, 4)
  ) %>%
  # Fiscal/calendar features
  mutate(
    # ISO week
    iso_week = isoweek(date),
    # Quarter
    quarter = paste0("Q", quarter(date)),
    # Year-Quarter label
    yr_q = paste0(year, "-", paste0("Q", quarter(date))),
    # Season (useful for this dataset which has temperature!)
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Summer",
      TRUE                    ~ "Autumn"
    ),
    # Temperature bands (unique to this dataset)
    temp_band = case_when(
      temperature < 5   ~ "Cold (<5°C)",
      temperature < 15  ~ "Mild (5-15°C)",
      temperature < 25  ~ "Warm (15-25°C)",
      TRUE              ~ "Hot (>25°C)"
    ),
    # Promotion type
    promo_type = case_when(
      promo_flag == 1 & discount_pct >= 0.30 ~ "Deep promo (30%+)",
      promo_flag == 1 & discount_pct >= 0.15 ~ "Mid promo (15-30%)",
      promo_flag == 1                         ~ "Light promo (<15%)",
      TRUE                                    ~ "Non-promo"
    )
  )

stopifnot(nrow(df_clean) == n_raw)
cat(glue("Cleaning complete. Rows: {nrow(df_clean)} (unchanged)\n"))
cat(glue("New columns added: margin_flag, stockout_contradiction,\n",
         "  discount_amt, effective_price, gross_margin_eur,\n",
         "  iso_week, quarter, yr_q, season, temp_band, promo_type\n"))
```

```{r}
flag_outlier <- function(x, n_sd = 3) {
  abs(x - mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)) > n_sd * sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
      total_net_sales <  quantile(total_net_sales, 0.20) &
        avg_margin >= 0.35   ~ "Niche (Low revenue + High margin)",
      total_net_sales <  quantile(total_net_sales, 0.20) &
        avg_margin <  0.35   ~ "Review (Low revenue + Low margin)",
      TRUE                   ~ "Mid-tier"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
segment_report <- function(df, group_col, min_rows = 100) {
  df %>%
    group_by({{ group_col }}) %>%
    summarise(
      n_rows          = n(),
      total_net_sales = round(sum(net_sales), 0),
      avg_net_sales   = round(mean(net_sales), 2),
      avg_margin_pct  = round(mean(margin_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      promo_rate      = round(mean(promo_flag) * 100, 1),
      avg_discount    = round(mean(discount_pct) * 100, 1),
      stockout_rate   = round(mean(stock_out_flag) * 100, 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(n_rows >= min_rows) %>%
    mutate(
      revenue_share = round(total_net_sales /
                              sum(total_net_sales) * 100, 2)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_net_sales))
}
 
cat("segment_report by category:\n")
```

```{r}
trend_summary <- function(df, value_col, group_col,
                          time_col = iso_week,
                          roll_window = 4) {
  df %>%
    group_by({{ group_col }}, {{ time_col }}) %>%
    summarise(
      value = sum({{ value_col }}, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange({{ group_col }}, {{ time_col }}) %>%
    group_by({{ group_col }}) %>%
    mutate(
      rolling_avg = slide_dbl(value, mean,
                              .before = roll_window - 1,
                              .complete = FALSE),
      rolling_sd  = slide_dbl(value, sd,
                              .before = roll_window - 1,
                              .complete = FALSE),
      is_anomaly  = abs(value - rolling_avg) >
                    2 * rolling_sd
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}
 
cat("\nTrend anomalies in net_sales by category:\n")
anomalies <- trend_summary(df_clean, net_sales, category) %>%
  filter(is_anomaly == TRUE) %>%
  count(category, sort = TRUE)
print(anomalies)
```

```{r}
daily_sales <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(date, category) %>%
  summarise(
    net_sales  = sum(net_sales),
    units_sold = sum(units_sold),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(category, date) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  mutate(
    roll_7d_sales  = slide_dbl(net_sales, mean,
                                .before = 6,
                                .complete = FALSE),
    roll_28d_sales = slide_dbl(net_sales, mean,
                                .before = 27,
                                .complete = FALSE),
    roll_7d_sd     = slide_dbl(net_sales, sd,
                                .before = 6,
                                .complete = FALSE),
    upper_2sd      = roll_7d_sales + 2 * roll_7d_sd,
    lower_2sd      = roll_7d_sales - 2 * roll_7d_sd,
    is_anomaly     = net_sales > upper_2sd |
                     net_sales < lower_2sd
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
 
cat("Daily sales anomalies by category:\n")
daily_sales %>%
  filter(is_anomaly) %>%
  count(category, sort = TRUE) %>%
  print()
```

```{r}
# STEP 1: ISOLATE — confirm the anomaly
monthly_bev <- df_clean %>%
  filter(category == "Beverages") %>%
  mutate(yr_month = format(date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
  group_by(yr_month) %>%
  summarise(
    net_sales  = sum(net_sales),
    units_sold = sum(units_sold),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_sales = mean(net_sales),
    sd_sales   = sd(net_sales),
    is_anomaly = net_sales < mean_sales - 1.5 * sd_sales
  )
 
worst_month <- monthly_bev %>%
  filter(is_anomaly) %>%
  arrange(net_sales) %>%
  pull(yr_month) %>%
  first()
 
cat("Step 1 — Anomaly months in Beverages:\n")
print(monthly_bev %>%
        filter(is_anomaly) %>%
        dplyr::select(yr_month, net_sales, is_anomaly))
 
if (!is.na(worst_month)) {
 
  # STEP 2: DECOMPOSE — which subcategory/brand drives the drop?
  prev_month <- format(as.Date(paste0(worst_month, "-01")) - 1,
                       "%Y-%m")
 
  step2 <- df_clean %>%
    filter(category == "Beverages",
           format(date, "%Y-%m") %in%
             c(prev_month, worst_month)) %>%
    mutate(period = format(date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
    group_by(period, subcategory) %>%
    summarise(net_sales = sum(net_sales), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = period,
                values_from = net_sales,
                values_fill = 0)
 
  cat("\nStep 2 — Decompose by subcategory",
      prev_month, "vs", worst_month, ":\n")
  if (ncol(step2) >= 3) {
    colnames(step2)[2:3] <- c("prev", "target")
    step2 <- step2 %>%
      mutate(pct_chg = round((target - prev) / prev * 100, 1)) %>%
      arrange(pct_chg)
    print(step2)
  }
 
  # STEP 3: DISTINGUISH CAUSE
  # Is it fewer promo days, stockouts, or lower base demand?
  step3 <- df_clean %>%
    filter(category == "Beverages",
           format(date, "%Y-%m") %in%
             c(prev_month, worst_month)) %>%
    mutate(period = format(date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
    group_by(period) %>%
    summarise(
      n_days        = n_distinct(date),
      promo_rate    = round(mean(promo_flag) * 100, 1),
      stockout_rate = round(mean(stock_out_flag) * 100, 2),
      avg_daily_rev = round(sum(net_sales) / n_distinct(date), 0),
      avg_discount  = round(mean(discount_pct) * 100, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
 
  cat("\nStep 3 — Promo/stockout vs revenue:\n")
  print(step3)
 
  # STEP 4: DOCUMENT
  cat(glue("\nStep 4 — RCA Summary:\n",
    "Worst month: {worst_month}\n",
    "Category: Beverages\n",
    "Recommendation: Check if promo_rate dropped or stockout_rate",
    " increased in {worst_month} vs {prev_month}.\n",
    "If promo_rate dropped → revenue loss driven by",
    " end of promotion, not market shift.\n",
    "If stockout_rate increased → supply chain issue",
    " — escalate to operations.\n"
  ))
}
```

```{r}
two_prop_ztest <- function(p1, n1, p2, n2, label1, label2) {
  p_pool <- (p1*n1 + p2*n2) / (n1+n2)
  se     <- sqrt(p_pool*(1-p_pool)*(1/n1+1/n2))
  z      <- (p1-p2)/se
  p_val  <- 2*(1-pnorm(abs(z)))
  tibble(
    Comparison = paste(label1, "vs", label2),
    Share1     = paste0(round(p1*100,2), "%"),
    Share2     = paste0(round(p2*100,2), "%"),
    Diff_pp    = round((p2-p1)*100, 2),
    Z_stat     = round(z, 3),
    P_value    = round(p_val, 4),
    Significant = p_val < 0.05
  )
}
```

```{r}
promo_uplift <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(sku_id, sku_name, promo_flag) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_daily_units = mean(units_sold),
    avg_daily_rev   = mean(net_sales),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols     = c(sku_id, sku_name),
    names_from  = promo_flag,
    values_from = c(avg_daily_units, avg_daily_rev),
    names_prefix = "promo_"
  ) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace(., "promo_0", "base"),
              contains("promo_0")) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_replace(., "promo_1", "promo"),
              contains("promo_1")) %>%
  mutate(
    unit_uplift_pct = round(
      (avg_daily_units_promo - avg_daily_units_base) /
        avg_daily_units_base * 100, 1),
    rev_uplift_pct = round(
      (avg_daily_rev_promo - avg_daily_rev_base) /
        avg_daily_rev_base * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(unit_uplift_pct))
 
cat("\nTop SKUs by promo unit uplift:\n")
print(head(promo_uplift %>%
             dplyr::select(sku_name, unit_uplift_pct, rev_uplift_pct), 10))
```
```{r}
weather_sales <- df_clean %>%
  filter(category == "Beverages") %>%
  group_by(date, temp_band, season) %>%
  summarise(
    net_sales    = sum(net_sales),
    units_sold   = sum(units_sold),
    temperature  = mean(temperature),
    rain_mm      = mean(rain_mm),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cor_temp <- cor(weather_sales$temperature,
                weather_sales$net_sales,
                use = "complete.obs")
 
cat(glue("Temperature vs Beverages sales correlation: {round(cor_temp,3)}\n"))
cat(case_when(
  cor_temp > 0.3  ~ "Positive correlation — hot weather drives sales\n",
  cor_temp < -0.3 ~ "Negative correlation — cold weather drives sales\n",
  TRUE            ~ "Weak correlation — temperature has limited impact\n"
))
 
```
```{r}
weather_summary <- weather_sales %>%
  group_by(temp_band) %>%
  summarise(
    n_days         = n(),
    avg_daily_rev  = round(mean(net_sales), 0),
    avg_daily_units = round(mean(units_sold), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(temp_band)
 
cat("\nBeverages sales by temperature band:\n")
print(weather_summary)
 
# Does rain affect sales?
cor_rain <- cor(weather_sales$rain_mm,
                weather_sales$net_sales,
                use = "complete.obs")
cat(glue("\nRain vs Beverages sales correlation: {round(cor_rain,3)}\n"))
```
```{r}
stockout_analysis <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(category, sku_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_days      = n(),
    stockout_days   = sum(stock_out_flag),
    stockout_rate   = round(mean(stock_out_flag) * 100, 2),
    avg_daily_rev_normal = mean(net_sales[stock_out_flag == 0],
                                na.rm = TRUE),
    # Estimate lost revenue = stockout days × avg normal daily rev
    est_lost_rev    = round(
      stockout_days *
        mean(net_sales[stock_out_flag == 0], na.rm = TRUE), 0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(stockout_days > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(est_lost_rev))
 
cat("Top SKUs by estimated lost revenue from stock-outs:\n")
print(head(stockout_analysis %>%
             dplyr::select(sku_name, stockout_days,
                    stockout_rate, est_lost_rev), 10) %>%
        mutate(est_lost_rev = paste0("€",
                 format(est_lost_rev, big.mark = ","))))
 
total_lost <- sum(stockout_analysis$est_lost_rev, na.rm = TRUE)
cat(glue("\nTotal estimated lost revenue from stock-outs: €",
         "{format(total_lost, big.mark=',')}\n"))
```
# Charts
```{r}
p1 <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(yr_month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(yr_month, category) %>%
  summarise(net_sales = sum(net_sales) / 1e3, .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = yr_month, y = net_sales, colour = category)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE,
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format(prefix = "€", suffix = "K")) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title    = "Monthly net sales by category (2021–2023)",
    subtitle = "Dashed = linear trend",
    x = NULL, y = "Net sales (€K)", colour = "Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

print(p1)
```

```{r}
p2 <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(category, promo_flag) %>%
  summarise(avg_margin = mean(margin_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(promo_flag = factor(promo_flag,
                             labels = c("Non-promo", "Promo"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(category, avg_margin),
             y = avg_margin * 100,
             fill = promo_flag)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Gross margin % — promo vs non-promo days",
    subtitle = "Promos typically compress margin",
    x = NULL, y = "Avg margin %", fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

print(p2)
```

```{r}
p4 <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(year, brand) %>%
  summarise(net_sales = sum(net_sales), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(share = net_sales / sum(net_sales) * 100) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(year), y = share,
             fill = brand)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title    = "Brand revenue share 2021–2023",
    subtitle = "Stacked = 100% of total store revenue",
    x = "Year", y = "Revenue share %", fill = "Brand"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "bottom")

print(p4)
```
